founder.heading: About the Founder
founder.photoAlt: Reid Peryam, Founder and Technology Strategist at GST
founder.p1: Reid Peryam is an architect and advisor with over 20 years of experience aligning technology, strategy, and people to drive business value.
founder.p2: He works with leadership teams across industries and continents; in M&A and transformation contexts, he partners on both the buy-side and sell-side to assess technology assets, identify material risks and opportunities, and execute results.
founder.p3: Reid founded GST to address a persistent gap in private equity and executive decision-making: the need for technology expertise grounded in business value. His work focuses on translating technical reality into strategic clarity, risk awareness, and an actionable path forward.
founder.credentials: Reid is a two-time alumnus of the University of California, Berkeley's Haas School of Business and also Boston University. GST's advisory work is grounded in long-term value creation and disciplined execution.
